candidates.change_summary: Change the call target for transferFrom so it calls transfer instead of transferFrom (modify selector to transfer(address,uint256)).
Require that the caller is not the zero address by adding require(msg.sender != address(0x0)) before loop.
Remove the check that address is not the contract itself; only check non-zero address.
Change the loop to iterate from 1 to tos.length (skip first recipient), altering which transfers are invoked.
